completenessCriteria.formalDefinition: A mechanical domain is 'complete' for the current executable slice when: (1) source segments are registered in an extraction artifact; (2) ambiguities are enumerated or explicitly marked not-applicable; (3) prototype decisions are recorded separately from source truth; (4) package-source catalogs, contracts, or metadata declare the domain; (5) runtime implements deterministic behavior or is explicitly disabled with documented reason; (6) discrepancy register records any gaps; (7) localization covers user-facing strings; (8) tests validate the behavior.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Expand Tribe catalog beyond Glass Walkers
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: Source documents 12+ tribes with mechanical data. Current runtime supports only Glass Walkers. Requires complete Tribe mechanical records for all playable tribes.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Renown initialization and semantics
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: DR-0005 explicitly blocks IMPLEMENT-019B. Source contains initial Renown by Auspice, temporary/permanent semantics, and Ragabash free-combination rules. Requires dedicated extraction and semantic review.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Complete generic Dice resolution algorithm extraction
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-001 and A-002 remain open. Exact algorithm for success, failure, botch, and specialization is not fully extracted from source. Runtime implements operation keys but without source-derived semantics. Includes Attribute + Ability test definition.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve health/damage extraction boundary
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: DR-0010 stopped PLAYABLE-003. Seven unresolved items: health-track structure, damage categories, mixed damage ordering, overflow, healing priority, wound penalties, incapacitation/death. Requires dedicated extraction document.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Ability catalog canonicalization
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-009 remains open. Portuguese source terminology must be mapped to stable English canonical keys. Affects all downstream artifacts, Dice inputs, and localization.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Lupus freebie spending timing
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-003 remains open. Source states Lupus restricted Abilities may be acquired later with freebie points, but timing is ambiguous. Current runtime restricts Lupus base allocation but does not implement freebie purchase.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve freebie points interaction with resources
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-006 and A-007 remain open. Current equals permanent is a prototype decision, not source truth. Freebie costs and interaction with permanent/current values are unresolved.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Tribe eligibility restrictions
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-016 remains open. Some Tribe descriptions may include identity or social restrictions that must not be silently converted to mechanical prohibitions without explicit source segments.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Metis deformity modeling
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-008 remains open. Current runtime supports horns only. Full deformity catalog with varied mechanical effects (penalties, conditions, missing Health levels) requires declarative effect modeling.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Resolve Metis and Race/Breed terminology
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: A-017 and A-018 remain open. Canonical technical keys for Race/Breed and Metis terminology must be stabilized before publication.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Extract remaining domains and resolve implementation decisions
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: These domains are present in source but not extracted or only partially materialized for current slice: combat, frenzy, forms, rites, umbra, spirits, totem mechanics and aggregation, progression, antagonists, pack creation, full Gift catalog and runtime, full Background catalog, full Tribe catalog, Fetishes/Talens, extended/resisted tests, remaining Character identity fields required by source-derived mechanics (specifically sex/gender field for Black Furies Tribe eligibility) and corresponding eligibility integration and validation, and implementation decisions for extracted domains (A-013, A-014). Requires dedicated extraction passes per EXTRACTION-0001 recommended order.

finiteCompletionBacklog.title: Update DisabledCapabilities to reflect all deferred domains
finiteCompletionBacklog.description: Current DisabledCapabilities omits spirits, totem-group-aggregation, pack-creation, and antagonists. Metadata should accurately reflect all out-of-scope mechanics.

reconciliations.subject: DR-0010 and PLAYABLE-003
reconciliations.finding: DR-0010 correctly stops PLAYABLE-003. No approved artifact authorizes health/damage mechanics. DR-0010 identifies exactly the same gaps this audit finds: health-track structure, damage categories, mixed damage ordering, overflow, healing priority, wound penalties, incapacitation/death. No contradiction.
reconciliations.action: No action required beyond existing DR-0010 boundary. Future PLAYABLE-003 must resolve all 7 DR-0010 items through dedicated extraction.

reconciliations.subject: DR-0005 and Renown
reconciliations.finding: DR-0005 explicitly blocks IMPLEMENT-019B. Renown is absent from runtime state and remains structurally present with null values. This audit confirms Renown is one of the largest source-covered gaps in current runtime.
reconciliations.action: No action required for current slice. Future Renown work must follow DR-0005 boundary or issue a new decision request superseding it.

reconciliations.subject: WEC-001 through WEC-009 and current runtime
reconciliations.finding: WEC-001 through WEC-008 are marked remediated. WEC-009 is an intentional limitation. Current runtime implements the remediated items. No new discrepancies found in this audit that contradict the existing register.
reconciliations.action: No action required. Future implementation increments may introduce new discrepancies that require register updates.

reconciliations.subject: Package metadata declared scope vs actual runtime
reconciliations.finding: Package manifest declares generic-dice and post-creation-character-operations as partial-executable. Runtime implements operation keys but generic dice semantics are source-pending (A-001, A-002). Metadata is slightly ahead of extraction completeness but not contradictory.
reconciliations.action: Either complete A-001/A-002 extraction or adjust capability status to 'declared-not-yet-execible' until extraction is complete.

mechanicalCompletenessBaseline.note: A domain is mechanically complete only when all required criteria are satisfied for the full registered source: complete source traversal, complete extraction, complete catalogs, executable deterministic mechanics, tests, and traceability. Disabled, blocked, deferred, excluded, partially catalogued, or partially materialized domains do not count as mechanically complete. Current-slice executable domains may be incomplete for full-source mechanical completeness.
